title: Impulse Space
description: Spaceflight monochrome: pure black bands for video and missions, pure white sections, a warm #f7f7f5 off-white for cards and the footer. Black or white ink with a 50% step, 16px radii, pill buttons, no shadows. One neo-grotesk at 400/600 with a plain grotesk mono for uppercase labels.
notes: light is the faithful mode (white page with black bands, which are .dark scopes); dark is a sibling with an all-black page and #111 cards
Host Grotesk stands in for ABC Monument Grotesk (closed) and DM Mono for Monument Grotesk Mono
the only colour is the CTA's hover light (glow = warm engine orange, highlight = cool blue)
